items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Good point. I remember Marian McPartland saying a similar thing... [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right, right, right, right. Yeah I mean in this art form hopefully it is about the music.

ctx.x: Well if we were to say the business is a microcosm of the world — you know — and we’re in an interesting time just dissecting gender, right? Like what does it really mean? So to me it doesn’t really mean anything in terms of picking up the guitar and playing it every day. Having two X chromosomes really doesn’t mean anything. I mean it’s not, you know, the physicality of the instrument — there’s nothing that would, you know, that I would need massive amounts of testosterone to be able to play it physically. So…
Good point. I remember Marian McPartland saying a similar thing — like with her wonderful accent you know, pointing out that oh she’s the finest woman jazz pianist.

Right, right, right, right, right. Yeah I mean in this art form hopefully it is about the music. We want it to be about the music.
